title: arXiv.org — Assumed non-exclusive license to distribute (the 1991–2003 submissions)
_comment: Uploaded by the owner 2026-10-02 (bean yc74), beside `arxiv-license-information`. Its own directory because an intake record — and the licence it states — covers one file. This is the licence that applies to every arXiv submission before January 2004, where the submission process captured no explicit licence at all; it is the case where a blank licence field is a determined fact rather than a gap.

files.note: 1 printed page. Names its own URI (http://arxiv.org/licenses/assumed-1991-2003/), the four terms arXiv operates on for pre-2004 submissions, and a revision history back to hep-th/9108001 (1991-08-14).

searched.result: states the licence arXiv assumes for pre-2004 SUBMISSIONS; says nothing about the licence of this licence-statement page

searched.where: the page's own 'Contact' link, its only navigation
searched.result: a contact route, not a licence statement

licence.note: The document STATES a licence — but that licence is the one arXiv assumes for other people's pre-2004 submissions, not the licence of this page. Recording the former as this capture's `licence` would be a category error, and it is the specific error this note exists to block.
